attributes.rule: <abbr title='Change of tariff heading'>CTH</abbr>: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 4-digit level (tariff heading).

A change to cut glassware from uncut glassware of [heading 7013](/headings/7013), whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of the non-originating uncut glassware does not exceed **50%** of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.
